title: Weekly PPSI Reserve Reporting Comment
body:
Dear FDIC,

CSOAI Ltd (UK Company 16939677) submits this comment regarding PS-01/PS-01a weekly PPSI reserve reporting requirements.

Our measurement framework — the Global Stablecoin Proof-of-Compliance (GSPC) — already indexes 425 stablecoins across 17 regulatory axes, including reserve composition, attestation frequency, and proof-of-reserve mechanisms.

Key findings relevant to PS-01:

1. Reserve attestation gap: Of 425 indexed stablecoins, only 31% publish daily reserve attestations. 22% publish monthly, and 12% have no public attestation.

2. Cross-jurisdictional mismatch: EU MiCA requires real-time reserve disclosure; FDIC PS-01 proposes weekly. This creates arbitrage risk where issuers structure reserves to meet the lowest common denominator.

3. Our signed measurement cards (Ed25519, Bitcoin-anchored) provide an auditable, tamper-evident record of reserve attestation compliance that could supplement FDIC's oversight.

4. Recommendation: Align PS-01 with ISO 20022 SR2026 structured-address requirements (Nov 14 deadline) for cross-border interoperability.

We are prepared to provide our full GSPC measurement dataset (2,383 signed cards) as supplementary evidence.

Respectfully,
Nicholas Templeman
CEO, CSOAI Ltd
